context: A uni intern is introduced to a corporate team
purpose: Teach: 長谷川/戸田/松下/原田/小島/大野/吉川/柴田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、こちらが長谷川部長、隣が戸田課長。
lines.en: Ren, this is Director Hasegawa. Next to him is Chief Toda.
lines.style: Calm, clear introduction. Light formality — the cadence of someone introducing peers. Even pacing, no rush. Confidence without ceremony.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: よろしくお願いします。松下さん、原田さんも、お世話になります。
lines.en: Thank you for having me. I appreciate your guidance too, Matsushita-san, Harada-san.
lines.style: Respectful bow in the voice — genuine gratitude with a thread of nervousness underneath. Careful pronunciation on the names. Slightly quick, like he's concentrating on getting it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 小島さんは出張で不在、大野さんが代行する。
lines.en: Kojima's away on business travel. Ono will cover his duties.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. No inflection needed — information only. Steady, like reading off logistics. The tone of someone accustomed to arranging details.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 吉川さん、柴田さんからも、現場のお話伺いたいです。
lines.en: I'd like to hear about the fieldwork from Yoshikawa and Shibata too.
lines.style: Slight lean forward in the voice. Attentive, genuinely curious — not performing interest. Quick, eager energy. The question of someone hungry to understand the real picture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん、来週、現場視察に連れて行く。
lines.en: Right. I'll take you out to the site next week.
lines.style: Brief, warm approval. A subtle nod in the voice — offering something good. Relaxed pace, like a small promise being made. Quiet confidence in his own word.
